proof_scope: Tau ticket repair releaser and handoff context contract against a disposable real Git repository

claims.proves: The runtime entrypoint compiles a tau.agent_handoff.v1 ticket context, launches without human terminal selection, pushes a repair branch to a disposable origin/main, reads back the remote ref, and removes the repair worktree.
claims.does_not_prove: Public GitHub mutation, provider/model semantic quality, branch protection, or human acceptance.

capability_claims.description: Tau can carry ticket-derived handoff context to launched agents and perform a guarded releaser phase after reviewer/proof PASS.

cases.name: ticket-repair-release-disposable-git
command: cd ../../../.. && out_dir="$HOME/.local/state/tau-agentic-evals/tau-326-release-positive" && rm -rf "$out_dir" && PYTHONPATH=src uv run python src/tau_coding/dag_runtime/ticket_repair_release.py --self-test --out-dir "$out_dir" && jq -e '.status == "PASS" and .mocked == false and .live == true and .handoff_context_readback.context.repo_path and .handoff_context_readback.context.cwd and .handoff_context_readback.context.worktree_path and .handoff_context_readback.context.tau_location and .handoff_context_readback.context.issue_id == "326" and (.handoff_context_readback.context.target_paths | index("src/tau_coding/dag_runtime/release-sentinel.txt")) and (.handoff_context_readback.context.required_skills | index("tau")) and (.handoff_context_readback.context.context_files | index("GOAL.md")) and (.handoff_context_readback.context.proof_command | length > 0) and (.handoff_context_readback.context.depends_on[0].state == "closed") and .handoff_context_readback.context.goal_hash and .handoff_context_readback.context.launch.automatic == true and .handoff_context_readback.context.launch.human_terminal_selection_required == false and .release_receipt_readback.status == "PASS" and .release_receipt_readback.cleanup_result.action == "removed" and .release_receipt_readback.cleanup_result.post_verified_absent == true and .release_receipt_readback.remote_main_sha == .release_receipt_readback.integrated_commit' "$out_dir/self-test-receipt.json"

cases.name: release-refuses-unsatisfied-dependency
command: cd ../../../.. && out_dir="$HOME/.local/state/tau-agentic-evals/tau-326-release-negative" && rm -rf "$out_dir" && PYTHONPATH=src uv run python src/tau_coding/dag_runtime/ticket_repair_release.py --self-test-negative --out-dir "$out_dir" && jq -e '.status == "PASS" and .release_receipt_readback.status == "BLOCKED" and (.release_receipt_readback.blockers | index("unsatisfied_depends_on"))' "$out_dir/self-test-receipt.json"
